sky.qualification: Comet-1p's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Horizons at the shared 3 September 2026 epoch; illustrative model orientation.
provenance.qualification: Computed Halley Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose. Historical Giotto/Vega shape model by Stooke, with pointing by Abergel. Absolute uncertainty is about 0.5–1 km; depressions may be exaggerated. Neutral gray is a model material. The source long axis and original origin are preserved. Orientation in space is illustrative and held fixed; no spin pole, tumble or current attitude reconstruction is claimed.
